figurative_meaning_en: The sound of fish splashing or jumping in shallow water
example_sentences_in_bangla: পুকুরের অল্প জলে খলবলানি শোনা যাচ্ছে।
গ্রামের বিলে মাছের খলবলানি সকালে উঠে শুনি।
example_sentences_in_english: The khalbalaani can be heard in the shallow pond water.
In the village marsh, we hear the khalbalaani of fish in the morning.
note: This is primarily an onomatopoeic expression rooted in everyday rural observations of aquatic life in Bengal.
